subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and CLI warning pieces are bounded, but endpoint names and 200/503 readiness behavior are operator-facing contracts on stable Gateway/CLI surfaces.

options.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
options.body: Add cron degradation to the existing readiness/health model without creating a new cron-only HTTP route.

options.title: Add Dedicated Cron Route
options.body: Implement `/health/cron` with explicit cron-only response and status semantics as a new public operator contract.

options.title: Stage Endpoint Semantics
options.body: Ship logs and `cron list` warnings first, then handle the health endpoint in a narrower owner-approved follow-up.

recommendation.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
recommendation.body: Add cron degradation to the existing readiness/health model without creating a new cron-only HTTP route.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the most detailed prior review context and has recent merged ownership over the cron timer/service helper split.
